User Question: Show me the revenue trend over the last 12 months
Response: Line Chart -- best for showing how a single continuous metric changes over a continuous time period.

User Question: Show cumulative sales growth across all quarters this year
Response: Area Chart -- highlights cumulative/volume trend over time better than a plain line when magnitude matters visually.

User Question: Compare total sales across each region
Response: Bar Chart -- best for comparing a metric across a small number of discrete categories.

User Question: Compare monthly revenue for Q1 vs Q2
Response: Column Chart -- vertical bars work well for comparing values across a short, ordered time-based category set.

User Question: What is the market share of each product category?
Response: Pie Chart -- appropriate for showing parts of a whole when there are few categories (ideally under 6).

User Question: Show revenue split by product category across each region
Response: Stacked Bar Chart -- shows both the total and the category-wise composition across multiple groups at once.

User Question: Show the proportion of customers by subscription tier
Response: Donut Chart -- functionally similar to a pie chart; used here for a modern dashboard look with a center KPI label.

User Question: Is there a relationship between marketing spend and revenue?
Response: Scatter Plot -- best for showing the correlation/relationship between two continuous numeric variables.

User Question: Compare products by sales, profit, and quantity sold together
Response: Bubble Chart -- extends a scatter plot with a third dimension (bubble size) for comparing three numeric variables at once.

User Question: Show the distribution of order values across all transactions
Response: Histogram -- best for showing the frequency distribution of a single continuous numeric variable across ranges (bins).

User Question: Compare the spread and outliers of delivery times by region
Response: Box Plot -- best for comparing distribution, median, and outliers of a numeric variable across categories.
Horizontal Bar Chart -- ideal for ranked lists, especially when category labels (product names) are long.

User Question: Show the customer conversion funnel from visit to purchase
Response: Funnel Chart -- purpose-built for showing sequential drop-off across ordered stages of a process.

User Question: Show total sales by country on a map
Response: Choropleth Map -- best when the data naturally maps to geographic regions and the question explicitly involves location.

User Question: Show number of active customers by city
Response: Point/Bubble Map -- best for point-based geographic data (cities, stores) rather than shaded regions.

User Question: Show revenue breakdown by category and sub-category
Response: Treemap -- best for showing hierarchical part-to-whole relationships across two or more nested levels.
Ambiguous: no metric breakdown, no time frame, and no comparison dimension specified. Expected system behavior: ask a clarifying question rather than defaulting silently to one chart type.
